title: Minecrap Title Text
description: Swaps the classic 'Minecraft' title for a sillier 'Minecrap' logo!
body: Give your main menu a sarcastic twist with this lightweight resource pack. It replaces the standard title with a **"Minecrap"** logo, crafted perfectly to match the original style while adding a humorous twist. It’s a simple, seamless tweak that works alongside your other favorite texture packs.
